title: Словарь имён42 утверждённых политических акторов Руанды для поиска корпуса
identity_policy: Exact approved IDs and order preserved. Name aliases are search strings, not verified author accounts. No handles or account IDs inferred.

priority_policy.1: Exactly one recorded canonical Latin full name and one recorded canonical Russian full name per actor.
priority_policy.2: Mechanical Latin diacritic stripping and punctuation, apostrophe or hyphen/space transformations of recorded names. Cyrillic letters, including й, remain unchanged. No inferred accents or speculative transliterations.
priority_policy.3: Short name or initials form explicitly present in a saved source title, plus four explicitly marked Kagame / Кагаме / Rwigara / Рвигара name components requiring context review.

query_generation: No Boolean queries generated here. The parent builder selects aliases under its5000-character total limit.
matching_notes: Case variants are not enumerated. Verify whether the provider treats queries as case-sensitive.

По предоставленному пользователем синтаксису кавычки поддерживают морфологические формы, поэтому падежные варианты отдельно не перечислены. Альтернативная транслитерация и иной порядок компонентов имени всё ещё могут не находиться.

A first-person original post may never name its own author. Retrieve such posts by separately verified platform author/account IDs or export metadata, rather than expecting name matching to recover them.
An account display name can change or belong to another person. Do not infer handles from a politician’s name, a URL slug, or this alias dictionary.
Quoted news can name several actors; a co-mention is not evidence of endorsement, shared position, or authorship.

Компоненты имён не объявляются наследственными фамилиями. Добавлены только Kagame / Кагаме и Rwigara / Рвигара с обязательной проверкой контекста; первые имена и остальные одиночные фрагменты не добавлялись.
Typographic variants may be redundant if the provider normalizes accents or punctuation; lower-priority alternatives need not consume the single-query budget.
